thread:
anya: Quick sync — planning doc for the enterprise compliance push is up. Need decisions on three things before next sprint: 1) retention tiers + exportability, 2) BYOK/KMS MVP scope, 3) legal-hold escape hatch. Link: https://docs.company/internal/compliance-roadmap :eyes:

drew: skimmed it. can we scope BYOK MVP to: CMK import + per-tenant key mapping, no HSM attestation initially? that cuts dev time.

sam: security strongly prefers KMS attestation on day 1 for finserv pilots. if we postpone, we need strict compensating controls and required customer signoff.

lena: legal: for regulated customers we must support legal-hold snapshots that prevent deletion even if retention expires. export format needs chain-of-custody metadata.

rami: several customers asked for configurable retention by SLA band (30/90/365) + manual archival export. they flagged the ability to export a signed proof as mandatory.

drew: ok for BYOK: proposal A = CMK import + per-tenant mapping (MVP), Proposal B = A + attestation + escrow handshake (phase 2). which do we pick?

anya: lean MVP (Proposal A) but add a blocker ticket: "attestation readiness gating for finserv customers" so sales/CS know constraints. also add acceptance criteria: - tenant can upload CMK - audit events emit key-id with every tokenization event - retention rules evaluated per-tenant - export payload includes hashes + signed manifest

sam: add requirement: immutable audit log for key operations (create/import/rotate/destroy) with WORM flag. SOC2 auditors will ask.

lena: on legal-hold: define an API toggle so legal ops can place a tenant/global hold. include TTL override for e-discovery workflows. we also need retention exception audit entry.

rami: can we prototype export UI + CLI in the MVP so customers can self-serve? some will want to pull evidence themselves before we build full concierge exports.

drew: timeline wise, team estimates MVP in 3 sprints if we limit to import + per-tenant binding + audit events. adding attestation pushes to 6 sprints.

anya: decision for planning: ship MVP (Proposal A) for Q3 beta with clear docs + CS playbook. mark attestation and escrow as Q4 items gated by security signoff. action items: @drew create import API RFC, @sam create attestation checklist, @lena draft legal-hold API contract language, @rami make CS pilot list and comms.

ops-bot: Reminder: created tracking epic COMPL-3125 and added acceptance checklist template.
